items.title: Harry "Sweets" Edison interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I have a cousin now with a camera there, Michael Schultz

ctx.x: That is going to be a thrill for us.

Yes? And I have a cousin now with a camera there, Michael Schultz, he’s a producer in movies so this is, I think he and I are about the only two who are in show business or some kind of movies. He’s a producer of movies. Much easier than playing the trumpet.
Playing the trumpet is one of the hardest things in the world.
